integrity: Proof includes all dimensions via a symbolic spectral decomposition; finite executable tests supplement rather than replace it. Historical originality and proof have not had an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Sharp only for equal unit-curvature scalar blocks, one sum equality, unit penalty, common fixed proximal coefficient, exact simultaneous solves and unrelaxed dual update; not the safeguarded adaptive algorithm or finite-time performance bound.
title: Sharp all-block convergence and rate-optimal proximal damping for parallel quadratic ADMM
